searchText: Some feedback on this would be great: https://ethresear.ch/t/a-mechanism-for-daily-autonomous-gas-price-stabilization/7762 My initial reaction is that if there really is more demand at one time than another, we would *want* the price to rise/fall throughout the day to encourage users with low time preference to shift operations to off peak.
